title: Step 7 - Simplifying Corpus: Using SnowballC Package to Remove Stop Words in R

cues.en: -: Hello, and welcome to this art tutorial.
cues.zh: 講師：大家好，歡迎來到 R 教學。

cues.en: So, so far we've been doing a great deal of simplifications for our corpus, and therefore for our future sparse matrix of features.
cues.zh: 目前對 corpus、因此未來稀疏特徵矩陣，已做很多簡化。

cues.en: But we can still do better.
And doing better is what we'll do in this tutorial.
And it's a new step of the cleaning process that is called stemming.
cues.zh: 新的清理步驟，叫詞幹提取。

cues.en: So what is stemming?
Well stemming is about getting the root of each word.
For example, if we look at the first review, we have this loved word here.
and the root of this word would be, love.
So what is the purpose of getting the roots of the word?
Well, it's of course still related to our goal to reduce the total number of words that will be in our future sports matrix of features.
cues.zh: 仍是為了降低未來稀疏特徵矩陣的總詞數。

cues.en: And we can do this by taking the root of the words, because whether we have loved, or love, or will love, or loving, well this actually means the same thing for our algorithm.
cues.zh: 取詞根就能做到，因為 loved、love、will love 或 loving，對演算法意思相同。

cues.en: And not only it means the same thing, but also it gives the same hint whether the review is positive or negative.
cues.zh: 不只意義同，也提供相同正負線索。

cues.en: So we don't really need to have some different tense of one same verb, and we don't really need to have derived words.
cues.zh: 不需要同一動詞不同時態，也不需要衍生詞。

cues.en: We just need the root of the words, and that will be perfectly enough for our machine learning classification model to train on the future sparse matrix and features that therefore will contain only
cues.zh: 只要詞根，就完全足夠讓分類模型在未來只含

cues.en: the roots of the words.
And you can imagine how we will considerably reduce the final total number of words that is the final total number of columns in the sparse matrix of features.
cues.zh: 可想像會大幅降低總詞數，也就是矩陣總欄數。

cues.en: Because of course, by only keeping the roots of the different versions of the same word, well of course, that simplifies it very well, and therefore considerably reduces the final total number of words.
cues.zh: 只留同詞各版本的根部，簡化很好，大幅減少詞數。

cues.en: So that's stemming.
That's also a very important step in natural language processing.
You will most of the time apply stemming to your text whether you are working with reviews or articles, or books, or HTML pages.
cues.zh: 多數時候都會用，不論評論、文章、書或 HTML。

cues.en: Well, for any kind of text, it really help your machine learning algorithm to do an even better job for your classification problem.
cues.zh: 各類文字都能幫分類演算法做得更好。

cues.en: So let's do it for our reviews, and it is still going to be very simple.
We will do another copy paste here.
So I will actually copy this line because we only need two parameters, the corpus, and a function that will perform the stemming.
cues.zh: 複製這行，因為只要 corpus 與提取詞幹函式兩參數。

cues.en: So (indistinct) here, and I will replace, remove punctuation by the appropriate function to proceed to the stemming, which is the stem capital D, document.
cues.zh: 貼這裡，把 removePunctuation 換成 stemDocument，D 大寫。

cues.en: Here it is.
That's the function we use to perform stemming on all the reviews of our purpose.
cues.zh: 用它處理 corpus 所有評論。

cues.en: So let's check it out.
Let's select this line.
Right now, our first review is "Wow. Loved place."
cues.zh: 目前第一則是 wow loved place。

cues.en: And you'll see that after stemming, loved becomes love.
cues.zh: 提取後 loved 變 love。

cues.en: All right, so let's execute now.
Press command or control plus enter, to execute.
cues.zh: Command 或 Ctrl 加 Enter。

cues.en: Here we go, new corpus updated.
And now let's have a look at the first review of this new corpus.
So I'm pressing the up arrow here to get this line of code.
And now pressing enter.
And here we go.
Wow, love and place.
So loved was replaced by love because the root of loved is love.
cues.zh: loved 換 love，因為根部是 love。

cues.en: All right, so, and that's the same for all the reviews, and in all the other reviews, the words were replaced by their roots.
cues.zh: 所有評論也一樣，各詞換成根部。

cues.en: So that's done for this new step.
And actually we are almost done with the cleaning process.
We have one final step, and we will do this final step in the next tutorial.
Until then, enjoy machine learning.
cues.zh: 在那之前，祝你享受機器學習的樂趣。
